title: Dense Representation Learning and Differentiable Shape Modeling for Spine Landmark Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.36951v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spine landmark detection from spinal X-ray is a key step for estimating spine deformation severity, for building biomechanical models, and for pre-operative planning. We reframe anatomical landmark detection as a pixel-level contrastive representation learning problem, matching dense pixel embeddings with landmark prototypes. Surprisingly, even with a generic U-Net backbone, this formulation results in more discriminative heatmaps compared to the traditional heatmap regression paradigm, leading to improved discrimination between vertebral corners on distinct vertebra. Furthermore, we combine the resulting heatmaps with learnable shape priors over the global configuration of spinal landmarks to resolve ambiguities in landmark locations, yielding a simple and practical approach to spinal landmark detection. translated_title: 脊柱关键点检测的密集表示学习与可微形状建模
translated_abstract: 从脊柱X光片中进行脊柱关键点检测是评估脊柱畸形严重程度、构建生物力学模型以及术前规划的关键步骤。我们将解剖学关键点检测重新构建为一个像素级对比表示学习问题，将密集像素嵌入与关键点原型进行匹配。令人惊讶的是，即使使用通用的U-Net骨干网络，这种构建方式相比传统的热图回归范式也能产生更具判别性的热图，从而更好地区分不同椎骨上的椎体角点。此外，我们将所得热图与可学习的形状先验相结合，对脊柱关键点的全局配置进行建模，以解决关键点位置中的歧义问题，从而提供了一种简单实用的脊柱关键点检测方法。在关键点检测精度和临床参数估计方面，我们的方法与公开数据集上的最先进方法具有竞争力。
tldr: 该论文将脊柱关键点检测重新构建为像素级对比表示学习问题，并结合可学习形状先验解决关键点位置歧义，在脊柱X光关键点检测精度和临床参数估计上达到了最先进水平。
en_tdlr: This paper reframes spine landmark detection as pixel-level contrastive representation learning and combines it with learnable shape priors to resolve landmark ambiguities, achieving state-of-the-art performance in both landmark accuracy and clinical parameter estimation on spinal X-rays.
